$comment: Observed UV4 file-stamp (F/I hash) samples and the confirmed producer function, for reproducing <project>_<target>.dep compatibility.

format_strings.header: Dependencies for Project '%s', Target '%s': (DO NOT MODIFY !)\r\n  @0xbdd9a8

notes: F records are written for source files only (file flag & 4 skips, .uvpdbg skips).
Multi-file groups are iterated via +0x14 / +0x18 next pointers; files flagged (byte+0x21 & 8) are skipped.
The command column comes from file+0x64 (per-file custom command) or the shared tool command string.
Newlines inside the command are rewritten to CR before writing (loop at 0x680cff..0x680f17).
I records are emitted after the F record only for files whose type byte (+0x20) is 1, 2 or 8 (C, assembler, C++).
Include list head is file+0x6c; each node {next@0, fullpath@2, hash@3}.

Hash kernel: FUN_00a8d486 -> FUN_00a8cc1a (mbs->wcs) -> FUN_00a8cc9b (CRT _stat64i32); the stamped 32-bit value is stat.st_mtime captured into the high half of the return value. F() and I() therefore store the dependency file's last-write time, not a content digest: renaming a file keeps the stamp, touching it changes it.
Delta check: main.c 0x6AE203ED*1000 = 1793197037000 <= mtime 1793197037453; the dep was written at that instant.

consequences_for_reimplementation.compare: file is stale when floor(mtime/1000) != stored stamp; content changes that keep mtime identical (same-second writes) are invisible to UV4's own .dep check
consequences_for_reimplementation.canonical_path: F paths keep the project-relative form; I paths are the full path list resolved by UV4 (absolute when outside the project)
